Attendee name: Monica Montero

attend this workshop.
Facilitators of workshop [] Cost [x]
Date and time of workshop [ ] Length of workshop []
Workshop topic [x] Other []
Please indicate whether or not you agree with the following statements.
Yes No
The facilitators presented information in a compelling manner. Ix] []

The knowledge and skills | gained will be useful at my job. [x] []
| would consider attending other workshops offered by these facilitators. [x] []
